name: OBD-II Diagnostic Knowledge Base, Failure Clusters & Telemetry Guide

failure_clusters.name: Unmetered Air / Vacuum Leak Cluster

live_data_signature.maf_reading: Appears normal or slightly low at idle

failure_clusters.physics_and_symptoms: Air enters intake tract downstream of the MAF sensor without being measured by the computer, causing a lean air-fuel ratio that causes random cylinder misfires.
common_causes: Cracked rubber intake accordion duct between MAF and throttle body
Hardened/cracked intake manifold gaskets (especially cold)
Perished or disconnected PCV breather hose
Leaking brake booster vacuum diaphragm
Loose or missing engine oil filler cap / dipstick seal
failure_clusters.diagnostic_test: Perform an automotive smoke test on intake tract or compare fuel trims at idle vs 2,500 RPM.
failure_clusters.youtube_query: how to diagnose vacuum leak fuel trims scannerdanner

failure_clusters.name: Contaminated / Failing Mass Air Flow Sensor

live_data_signature.fuel_trims_2500_rpm: Remains elevated positive (+15% to +25%) - does NOT normalize
live_data_signature.maf_reading: Significantly under-reporting (e.g. 1.8 g/s on a 3.0L engine at warm idle)

failure_clusters.physics_and_symptoms: Contaminants or oil film on the heated platinum wire insulates it from airflow, causing the ECU to calculate less incoming air mass than reality.
common_causes: Dust and debris on MAF sensing wire
Excess oil from reusable aftermarket air filters
Corroded sensor electrical connector pins
failure_clusters.diagnostic_test: Check hot idle MAF reading in g/s against engine displacement in liters. Clean with MAF cleaner.
failure_clusters.youtube_query: diagnose dirty MAF sensor live data scannerdanner

failure_clusters.name: Catalytic Converter Degradation Cluster

live_data_signature.downstream_o2_sensor_2: Rapidly oscillates (0.1V to 0.9V), mirroring Sensor 1 instead of holding a flat 0.55V-0.70V line

failure_clusters.physics_and_symptoms: The precious metal substrate has lost its ability to store oxygen. Exhaust gases pass through untreated without chemical reduction of NOx or oxidation of CO/HC.
common_causes: Thermal meltdown from raw unburned fuel burning inside converter (chronic misfires)
Engine oil burning (phosphorus poisoning from worn valve seals/rings)
Exhaust leak directly ahead of or near the catalytic converter
Silicon poisoning from non-sensor-safe silicone sealant
failure_clusters.diagnostic_test: Graph Upstream vs Downstream O2 sensor voltages on oscilloscope display in closed-loop cruise.
failure_clusters.youtube_query: how to test catalytic converter P0420 live data scannerdanner

failure_clusters.name: Thermostat Stuck Open / Under-Temperature

live_data_signature.engine_coolant_temp: Fails to reach 85°C-95°C; plateaus at 60°C-72°C during driving
live_data_signature.loop_status: Reverts to Open Loop or high warm-up fuel enrichment

failure_clusters.physics_and_symptoms: Coolant circulates continuously through the radiator even when cold, preventing the engine from reaching closed-loop operating temperature.
common_causes: Mechanical thermostat stuck open by broken return spring
Perished rubber sealing ring on thermostat valve
Defective Engine Coolant Temperature (ECT) sensor
failure_clusters.diagnostic_test: Monitor ECT rise time from cold start. Feel upper radiator hose: should remain cold until thermostat snaps open at ~88°C.
failure_clusters.youtube_query: diagnose P0128 thermostat stuck open live data

failure_clusters.name: Variable Valve Timing / Timing Chain Stretch

live_data_signature.camshaft_advance_angle: Phase error between commanded and actual cam angle exceeds 10°
live_data_signature.calculated_load: Elevated at idle due to valve timing inefficiency

failure_clusters.physics_and_symptoms: Chain elongation or clogged VVT phaser prevents camshaft from aligning with crankshaft timing marks.
common_causes: Stretched timing chain from neglected oil change intervals
Worn timing chain guides and collapsed hydraulic tensioner
Clogged mesh filter screens in VVT oil control solenoids
failure_clusters.diagnostic_test: Dual-channel oscilloscope capture comparing Crankshaft Position (CKP) and Camshaft Position (CMP) waveforms.
failure_clusters.youtube_query: diagnose P0016 crank cam correlation timing chain

failure_clusters.name: Charging System Brownout & Phantom Codes

live_data_signature.control_module_voltage: Drops below 11.5V while running (normal charging is 13.5V to 14.5V)

failure_clusters.physics_and_symptoms: When voltage drops below microchip logic thresholds, communication between modules drops out and multiple 5V sensor circuits register false low-input codes.
common_causes: Failing alternator / worn carbon brushes / blown diode bridge
Loose or corroded negative battery terminal clamp
Broken or rusted chassis ground strap between engine block and unibody
failure_clusters.diagnostic_test: Check voltage drop across battery terminals and alternator B+ stud with engine idling and accessories on.
failure_clusters.youtube_query: diagnose P0562 low system voltage south main auto

06_07_08_09.meaning: Short Term (STFT) is instantaneous closed-loop correction; Long Term (LTFT) is learned adaptive correction stored in ECU memory. Total Fuel Trim = STFT + LTFT.
06_07_08_09.diagnostic_rule: Total Trim > +10% indicates lean (adding fuel). Total Trim < -10% indicates rich (subtracting fuel). High positive trim at idle that drops at 2,500 RPM confirms a vacuum leak.

0C.meaning: Rotational speed of engine crankshaft calculated by CKP sensor.
0C.diagnostic_rule: Erratic dropouts to 0 RPM during cranking indicate a faulty crankshaft position sensor.
0C.youtube_search: test engine RPM sensor crankshaft sensor

0D.meaning: Road speed derived from transmission or wheel speed sensors.
0D.diagnostic_rule: If speedometer fluctuates or transmission fails to shift, compare live VSS PID against GPS speed. Physical pulse frequency (Hz) is approximately Speed (mph) * 1.111 Hz for standard 4-pulse/rev sensors.

05.meaning: Thermal status of engine coolant measured by NTC thermistor.
05.diagnostic_rule: If stuck under 75°C during highway cruise, thermostat is stuck open (P0128). If exceeding 105°C, cooling system failure is active.
05.youtube_search: test engine coolant temperature sensor ECT

10.normal_range: Approximately 1.0 g/s per liter of engine displacement at warm idle (e.g. 3.0 g/s for 3.0L V6)
10.meaning: Mass of air entering the engine intake tract.
10.diagnostic_rule: At wide open throttle (WOT) at redline, g/s should reach roughly 80% of peak engine horsepower. Under-reporting at idle causes lean codes.
10.youtube_search: calculate MAF sensor grams per second rule of thumb

14_15.meaning: Sensor 1 measures raw exhaust oxygen before catalyst. Sensor 2 measures exhaust oxygen after catalyst.
14_15.diagnostic_rule: Sensor 1 must switch rapidly 1-2 times per second. If Sensor 2 mimics Sensor 1 switching, the catalytic converter has lost oxygen storage capacity (P0420).
14_15.youtube_search: how to read oxygen sensor live data on scan tool

04.normal_range: 15% to 25% at hot idle in Park/Neutral
04.meaning: Current airflow as a percentage of maximum theoretical peak airflow at current RPM.
04.diagnostic_rule: High idle load (>35%) with A/C off indicates mechanical engine drag, retarded valve timing, or restricted exhaust flow.
04.youtube_search: calculated engine load OBD2 live data explained
